entries.heading: REDUCTION IN REQUIRED NUMBER OF MEMBERS OF DISCHARGE REVIEW BOARDS
ancestors: Subtitle C—General Service Authorities and Correction of Military
entries.text:
SEC. 522. REDUCTION IN REQUIRED NUMBER OF MEMBERS OF DISCHARGE 
                        REVIEW BOARDS.

    Section 1553(a) of title 10, United States Code, is amended by 
striking ``five'' and inserting ``not fewer than three''.

[[Page 133 STAT. 1354]]
